panels.art_direction: Front panel with warm citrus palette, deep teal accent, and soft gold border. Headline area has generous margins and a clean text-safe space. The border style is a hand-drawn, uneven line, and the motifs are small, interlocking gears.

The panel features a hand-drawn, uneven border with a deep teal accent and small, interlocking gears as motifs. The background is a warm citrus color, and the overall design feels handmade and polished.

memory_citations: The customer chose an independent small business instead of a large marketplace.
The owner wants the message to feel handmade, specific, and grateful rather than promotional.
CustomCard needs editable copy overlays, print-safe margins, persistence, and human review before external sharing.
